compat.text: SikaRoof® MTC-20 UV is a cold-applied, seamless, highly elastic and UV-stable moisture triggered polyurethane roof waterproofing system consisting of Sikalastic®- 488 and Sikalastic®- 701. Suitable for use in hot and tropical climatic conditions.
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: Standard SikaRoof® MTC-20 UV application without non-slip addition: Layer Product Required DFT 1. Primer Sikalastic® Moisture Seal or Sikalastic®- 100 EP
compat.heading: SYSTEM INFORMATION

compat.text: Do not apply SikaRoof® MTC on substrates with rising moisture.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: SikaRoof® MTC is not suitable for permanent water immersion.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use SikaRoof® MTC for indoor applications.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply close to the air intake vent of a running air conditioning unit.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply SikaRoof® MTC directly on insulation boards.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply cementitious products (e.g. tile mortar) directly onto SikaRoof® MTC
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: concrete, existing coatings (after adhesion and compatibility testing is confirmed) , metal, brickwork, asbestos cement, ceramic tiles.
